messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: [INC-2026-04] Potential trace-export degradation — multiple OTLP/gRPC errors to Honeycomb observed across regions. Paging on-call. Root error snippet: 

```
error: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z exporter/honeycomb: failed to send batch: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
```

OnCall Pager: Maya, you're up — can you ack and take a look? @Maya Patel

Maya Patel: acked. I'm jumping in. First pass: dashboards show a sudden drop in spans ingested starting ~10:11 UTC, traces buffered at our forwarders. No obvious service-side errors.

Sam Ortiz: seeing same. forwarding service logs show repeated gRPC code=14/Unavailable. exporter restart doesn't recover — it immediately hits same errors.

Maya Patel: probable upstream (Honeycomb) or network path. Quick mitigations: 1) switch forwarders to local file buffer + async retry; 2) reduce sampling to 0.5 to avoid buffer blowups; 3) route to secondary export sink (S3) for durability. Doing 1 & 2 now.

Liam Chen: FYI I already opened a support ticket with Honeycomb from our monitoring alerting webhook (ticket #HC-8721). Paste of message sent: 

```
Timestamp: 2026-03-15T10:14:22Z
Subject: OTLP/gRPC failures from Redwood forwarders (region-us-west1)
Symptoms: grpc Unavailable, connection closed from multiple hosts starting 10:11 UTC.
Impact: traces failing to export; traces buffered at edge-forwarders. No evidence of dropped production requests but tracing gaps for customers.
```

Honeycomb Support Bot: Thanks for the report. We've received HC-8721 and are investigating. We'll update within 30 minutes.

Tara Nguyen: quick question — are any customers actively reporting problems? I can search the support queue.

Sam Ortiz: Support: a couple of customers reported missing trace spans in their dashboards (customer: FinScale, ID FS-203; and CommerceKit, CK-44). No service errors reported.

Maya Patel: mitigation update: switched forwarders to local disk buffering and reduced sampling to 25% (was 100%). Command used: 

```
kubectl -n observability exec deploy/forwarder -- 
/opt/forwarder/bin/forwarder --set exporter.honeycomb.enabled=false \
  --set exporter.local_buffer.enabled=true --set sampling.rate=0.25
```

Initial effect: buffer size up but exporters keep hitting gRPC Unavailable when draining. We're pausing active drains to avoid retries spamming. Holding buffered spans to persist to S3.

Liam Chen: initiated S3 fallback — bundles are being written to s3://redwood-traces-fallback/2026-03-15/ — I'm running an integrity check on objects as they land.

Maya Patel: I'm also flipping tracing realtime alerts to advisory (no pager) to avoid alert noise while we stabilize.

IncidentBot: Note: incident severity tallied as SEV2 due to multiple customers affected with degraded observability.

Tara Nguyen: drafting status page update: "We are investigating trace export failures to Honeycomb impacting trace visibility for some customers. No compute/service downtime observed." Want to post after you confirm mitigations, Maya.

Maya Patel: go ahead and prepare draft but hold publish until we have a clear fallback written and vendor ETA.

Sam Ortiz: logs from forwarder attached (excerpt): 

```
2026-03-15T10:13:10Z forwarder-1 exporter.go:128 WARN exporter/honeycomb: send failed: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
2026-03-15T10:13:12Z forwarder-2 exporter.go:128 WARN exporter/honeycomb: send failed: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-15T10:13:15Z forwarder-3 exporter.go:128 INFO exporter/local_buffer: writing batch to disk /var/lib/forwarder/buffer/0000001234
```

Maya Patel: next steps I'm coordinating: (A) Keep buffering locally + S3 fallback; (B) continue talk with Honeycomb support — ask for root cause and region scope; (C) prepare runbook for customer outreach if we see >4 customers affected or >1 hour impact.

Honeycomb Support Bot: Update on HC-8721: We are seeing elevated gRPC errors due to a misconfiguration on a routing cluster in us-west1. Mitigation in progress; tentative fix deployment within 20 minutes. We'll confirm once rollout completes.

Liam Chen: good. I'm keeping the fallback writer running. Writing a short script to rehydrate S3 bundles into our internal trace replayer once vendor is healthy. Sharing gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/replay-script

Tara Nguyen: I prepped a customer email template. Will wait for a go/no-go.

Maya Patel: I'm going to step out at 10:35 UTC for a quick break. Sam, can you take lead patching in case Honeycomb fix doesn't fully clear? I'll leave notes below and handoff to you.

Sam Ortiz: taking lead. Handoff notes from Maya: 
- Buffers: /var/lib/forwarder/* latest files timestamped 10:20-10:32
- S3 path: s3://redwood-traces-fallback/2026-03-15/
- Sampling reduced to 25% (revert once stable)
- Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/trace-export-failure

Maya Patel: also note: DO NOT re-enable honeycomb exporter until Honeycomb confirms the cluster is healthy — re-enabling will cause immediate retries.

IncidentBot: Handoff recorded. Paging next on-call in 30 minutes if unresolved.

Honeycomb Support Bot: HC-8721 update: fix rolled out at 10:40 UTC to the routing layer in us-west1. We've observed a drop in gRPC Unavailable errors and backlog draining slowly. Please monitor.

Sam Ortiz: seeing fewer errors; one forwarder drain started to succeed at 10:44 UTC. Starting a controlled unpause of exporters on a single canary host to validate.

Maya Patel: thanks. Re: customer comms — we should notify impacted customers that we experienced trace export degradation from 10:11–10:45 UTC; full data will be available via rehydration from S3 within 2 hours. Tara, can you send that once I sign off?

Tara Nguyen: will queue it and wait for sign-off.

Sam Ortiz: canary looks good. Drain rate steady and no spike in errors. I'm slowly scaling exporter replicas back up and watching for retries.

Maya Patel: I'm back. Verified the handoff. Summary for the incident thread: 
- Root cause: Honeycomb routing cluster misconfiguration caused gRPC Unavailable errors for OTLP exports in us-west1.
- Customer impact: Trace visibility gaps for a subset of customers (FinScale, CommerceKit). No request-level downtime.
- Mitigation: disabled direct exporter, buffered to disk, wrote bundles to S3, engaged vendor, vendor rolled fix.
- Recovery: exports draining successfully; will rehydrate S3 bundles to backfill traces.
- Next actions: (1) replay S3 bundles into trace ingest pipeline (Liam); (2) monitor for reintroduced errors for 2 hours (Sam); (3) publish status update after backfill begins (Tara).

IncidentBot: Incident status: transitioning to monitoring. SEV2 -> SEV3 as visibility restored. Please update runbook checkboxes and close when backfill completes. :white_check_mark:

Liam Chen: starting rehydration job now. ETA to finish backfill ~90 minutes depending on bundle size. Will post progress updates.

Tara Nguyen: published customer advisory at 10:58 UTC after Maya sign-off.

Sam Ortiz: I'll keep the exporter watch active and will escalate if any gRPC errors recur.

Maya Patel: thanks team. I'll file a post-incident note with timeline and improvement suggestions (better exporter throttling, more resilient retries, vendor SLAs). Closing handoff to Sam and Liam for monitoring/replay.

Sam Ortiz: acknowledged.

Liam Chen: noted. I'll update when backfill completes.

IncidentBot: Thread closed for active paging. Re-open if further degradation detected."
